name: Newsroomie
author: Newsroomie.com

sections.description:
This membership plug-in helps publishers and content creators grow their traffic, members and revenue and give you and your visitors a smooth experience, so you can focus on creating unique and top-notch content.

How does it work?

With Contentlockr you can make your WordPress-content exclusive for leads and/or members only. People can unlock content and become a lead in just a few clicks. By registering with LinkedIn, Google or Facebook or by filling in their email address.

Becoming a member has never been a smoother ride since the people of Newsroomie introduced Superfast Checkout. It’s not just a paywall, because your visitors can checkout first and pay later. But if you want, you can directly ask visitors for their money too.

Marketing Zones let you target visitors, leads and members with personalized marketing on your WordPress-website. For example, to explain leads why it’s a freaking good idea to become a member. You can schedule textual messages, images, videos and HTML-ads on your marketing zones and see what works best.

Member management gives you fancy graphs and numbers about your leads and members, how fast your audience is growing and how much recurring revenue you generate.

To keep your leads and members engaged Mail let you create a newsletter of your WordPress-content in less than a minute. Leads and members will be automatically logged-in on your website, just by following a link in your emails. Feel free to add personalized marketing.

Member-get-member let you expand your brand through existing leads and members. Encourage them to invite colleagues, friends, mom, dad and other people in their network. Reward referrals and welcome new members with access to content, features and special discounts.

Highlighted features

  • Contentlockr

    • Make your content accessible for (new) leads or members only
    • Make unlocking content easy with just a few clicks with Google, LinkedIn or by clicking a link in an email
    • Customize call-to-action under each post
    • See what content converts best

  • Superfast checkout

    • Pre-filled forms
    • Sell multiple subscriptions
    • Checkout first, pay later
    • Advanced bot protection and form validation

  • Marketing Zones

    • Show targeted marketing to leads, members or anonymous visitors
    • Choose between HTML, images, textual messages or videos
    • See what marketing works best

  • Member Management

    • One CRM to manage your leads and members
    • Send invoices and reminders
    • Financial statistics
    • Manage memberships

  • Mail

    • Create a newsletter in just a few clicks
    • Personalized marketing in mail and on website
    • Automatically logged-in on website

  • Member-get-member

    • Encourage leads and members to invite their contacts
    • Reward referrals and welcome new members with access to content, features or special discounts

  • Integrations

    • WordPress
    • Mailchimp
    • Copernica
    • Mollie
    • Stripe
    • Zapier
    • Abonnementenland

Missing your favorite tool in this list? Let us know by dropping us an email at info@newsroomie.com.

  • Support
    • Dedicated success manager who helps you grow your audience
    • Onboarding

Sounds great. How do I get started?

  1. Go to https://newsroomie.com/get-started and fill in the form
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins and click “Add new”
  4. Search for “Newsroomie” and Install and Activate it.
  5. Newsroomie plugin appears in the menu on the left-hand side
  6. Select “Settings” under Newsroomie
  7. Paste your Publisher ID and API-key in the email we’ve sent you
  8. You can now start generating Leads and make each Post exclusive for New leads, Leads, Members or everyone (in the first couple of hours).

Do you have a question? Drop us an email at info@newsroomie.com or go to https://newsroomie.com.

Remote files

The following files are needed to render marketing content (loaded through our API) correctly on the website and collect statistics. We’ve opted to load these files remotely as they’re subject to small and frequent changes. These files are only loaded if you have the tenant set in the config (and you are a Newsroomie customer).

  • https://cdn.prdn.nl/sdk/latest/main.min.css
  • https://cdn.prdn.nl/sdk/latest/main.min.js

External services

Thirdparty authentication
This plugin connects to the Google and LinkedIn auth API’s which will allow visitors to create a WordPress account using their Google or LinkedIn accounts.
The initial call will be done through our own authentication API after which subsequent calls will be done to Google’s and LinkedIn’s own auth API’s to finalize the account creation. This authentication API is needed so it’s not necessary for the party that installs the plugin to create and configure their own Google and LinkedIn dev accounts.

Google APIs Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
Google API Services User Data Policy: https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy
LinkedIn API Terms of Use: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/l/api-terms-of-use
LinkedIn Privacy Policy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy

Newsroomie API
The plugin will make calls to the Newsroomie API at https://*.api.prdn.nl/api.

This connection will allow:
* Synchronizing users from WordPress to Newsroomie to allow setting up mailing campaigns.
* Loading marketing content from Newsroomie into the WordPress website.
* Collect statistics regarding marketing content and pageviews.

Newsroomie Terms and Conditions: https://newsroomie.com/terms
Newsroomie Privacy Policy: https://newsroomie.com/privacy
